prohibitions: No runtime identity may be SUPERUSER or BYPASSRLS.
Application and operator identities must not own protected tables.

identities.purpose: Serve authenticated application commands inside canonical transaction-local actor context.
identities.ownershipExpectations: Owns no schema, table, policy, or SECURITY DEFINER function.
identities.credentialSource: Runtime secret manager injection; exact production secret and rotation design unresolved.
auditRequirements: Record actor, tenant, command, assurance, policy version, result, and request ID without secrets or row payloads.

identities.purpose: Execute explicitly approved read-only RLS transactions for canary/read routes.
identities.credentialSource: Dedicated runtime secret; never derived through SET ROLE from the application identity.
auditRequirements: Record route, actor, tenant, policy revision, and denial class.

identities.purpose: Invoke only named pre-authentication security functions without direct protected-table access.
identities.ownershipExpectations: Owns no objects and is not a member of function-owner roles.
identities.credentialSource: Application runtime secret or the authenticated app credential if grants remain exactly equivalent; decision pending.
auditRequirements: Record function name, generic outcome, request ID, replay/rate-limit decision; never record tokens or credentials.

identities.purpose: Run a bounded worker command with job-derived, independently verified tenant scope.
identities.credentialSource: Per-worker or per-job-family runtime secret; exact split unresolved.
auditRequirements: Record job ID/type, verified tenant, authorization version, attempts, result, and idempotency key.

identities.purpose: Run an approved schedule using tenant iteration or a narrow database function, never global bypass.
identities.credentialSource: Scheduled runtime secret distinct from interactive application credentials.
auditRequirements: Record schedule revision, tenant/job scope, counts, failures, and retry evidence.

identities.purpose: Apply reviewed schema migrations in a separate controlled deployment phase.
identities.ownershipExpectations: May create/alter reviewed public objects; must not be the enduring table owner.
identities.credentialSource: Deployment-only secret unavailable to application, workers, and humans outside approved release execution.
auditRequirements: Record migration checksum, actor/release, start/end, target, and catalog postconditions.

identities.purpose: Own protected tables and policies so ordinary runtime roles cannot bypass FORCE RLS through ownership.
identities.ownershipExpectations: Owns protected tables/policies only; not usable as an application execution identity.
identities.credentialSource: No credential; NOLOGIN role managed by reviewed administration.
auditRequirements: Catalog tests prove NOLOGIN, NOBYPASSRLS, NOSUPERUSER, membership and ownership bounds.

identities.purpose: Own exact named SECURITY DEFINER functions with only their required column privileges.
identities.ownershipExpectations: Owns approved app_auth functions only; owns no tables or schemas beyond the reviewed boundary.
auditRequirements: Catalog tests prove owner, fixed search_path, exact grants, PUBLIC revoke, and no role reachability.

identities.purpose: Perform separately approved staging-only administration and evidence collection.
identities.ownershipExpectations: Does not own application tables; temporary administration grants are explicit and audited.
identities.credentialSource: Time-bound staging operator credential through the approved broker path.
auditRequirements: Capture approval, operator, exact command/checksum, target guard, start/end, and immutable evidence.

identities.purpose: Time-bound production incident administration under dual approval and recorded purpose.
identities.ownershipExpectations: Owns no objects and receives no standing membership in owner roles.
identities.credentialSource: Ephemeral broker-issued credential after dual approval and strong MFA.
auditRequirements: Immutable session transcript, incident/ticket, approvers, exact scope, expiry, commands, rows affected, and credential revocation.
